title: If a Bear Charges You, Never Run — Do This Instead
description:
A bear stands up on the trail ahead of you, and every instinct screams RUN. If you listen to that instinct, you lose. Here are 7 animal encounters and the exact right move for each one — because the right move is almost never the one your body wants to make.

⏱️ CHAPTERS
0:00 Your instincts are wrong
0:22 #7 An aggressive dog
0:56 #6 A swarm of bees
1:26 #5 A snake bite
1:58 #4 A shark, way too close
2:29 #3 An angry moose (the twist)
2:59 #2 A mountain lion
3:34 #1 A bear on the trail
4:13 The pattern behind all seven

Which of these animals have YOU come face to face with? Tell me in the comments.

🔔 Subscribe: one new survival-facts video every week.

DISCLAIMER: General safety information only. Wild animals are unpredictable — always follow guidance from park rangers and local wildlife authorities.
